title: transition v1
description: One DJ-style handover from one track to another (docs/analytics.md, Mixing). DJ Mix writes one when the crossfader goes from one playing deck, through both, to the other. The envelope's track_key is the incoming track's.

from_track_id.description: Library track id on the device that wrote it.

kind.description: beatmatched when SYNC held both decks on the beat.

length_ms.description: From both decks audible to only the incoming one.

tempo_shift_pct.description: Speed change on the incoming track, percent.

manual.description: The DJ moved the crossfader, rather than BLEND or Mix into next.
